scheme_name: Short Term Fellowship under the Human Resource Development Programme for Health Research
other_conditions: Must be an Indian citizen working in an Indian institute.
Must hold an MD/MS/MDS or MBBS/BDS/MVSc./M.Sc./M.Pharma/M.Tech or equivalent with a Ph.D. in health/biomedical research.
Must be a faculty member with at least three years of experience as a regular employee in the college/institute.
Age must be up to 55 years as of the last date of receipt of application.
Must not have previously availed any fellowship of one month or more from any Government of India or State Government agency for the same subject of training/research.
Fellowship duration is 1-3 months and is non‑transferable.
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹40,000 per month (₹20,000 if training at the same station) for Indian institute fellowships and $3,000 per month for foreign institute fellowships, plus travel and contingency grants.
